record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the existing prefix-length feature with log1p(min(prefix_length, 16))/log(17), keeping padding zero. Saturation may improve discrimination among short observed prefixes while limiting feature growth on long histories. Compute prefix lengths causally from observed input interactions only. Keep frequency features, learned embeddings and projection, causal convolution topology, readout, loss, optimizer and training settings fixed. Train one independent model per category and apply the identical feature formula through the predictor writer.
